What I doMaking it simple

I’m Ayush, a graphic and UI/UX designer who brings visual identity and digital products together. Since 2023, I’ve created more than 10 web interfaces for international clients and maintained a 5.0/5 client rating. I’m also part of PHOENIX’s graphic team, the founder of PlacementDo, and a first-place winner of the UX Factor Competition at Avenir 2026. I combine thoughtful design with hands-on development to create distinctive digital experiences that work smoothly across platforms.
